## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Search ad, headline "Tea Subscription UK" plus one description, for the UK.

**Claims**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Monthly loose leaf tea" | Product fact, fine as written |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list (subscription terms) |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list (shipping policy), exact wording |

**Regulated claims:** The ad has no health, money, environmental, children or price-promotion claims. "Free delivery" carries its condition (over £25), so it isn't misleading.

**House style:** The copy is plain and has no banned words or AI tells. The tone is a bit terse for "warm, plain, unhurried", but that's normal for a search ad. Score is about 85, so no rewrite is needed.

**Disclosure:** This is a paid ad from our own account, which the platform marks, so no extra label is needed. There are no creators, affiliate links or AI-generated images.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing is blocking. One practical note: the description is about 102 characters. If this is a standard responsive search ad, descriptions are capped at 90, so it may need trimming or splitting into two descriptions. That's a platform fit issue, not a policy one. A trim that keeps both claims intact: "Monthly loose leaf tea. Pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery over £25." Because it reuses the policy wording, check it against the claims list again if you change it.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Nothing has been approved yet, and I haven't recorded an approval. Sam needs to give an explicit yes to this exact final text before it goes live.
